question: Which public retirement system covers me, and who runs it?

gold_sections.ref: Md. Code, State Personnel and Pensions § 21-101
Md. Code, State Personnel and Pensions § 21-102
Md. Code, State Personnel and Pensions § 21-103
Md. Code, State Personnel and Pensions § 31-102

nuggets.text: Maryland has a State Retirement and Pension System.
nuggets.section: Md. Code, State Personnel and Pensions § 21-101
nuggets.quote: There is a State Retirement and Pension System.

nuggets.text: It consists of the several systems (employees', teachers', law enforcement, state police, judges' and others).
nuggets.section: Md. Code, State Personnel and Pensions § 21-102
nuggets.quote: the Employees’ Pension System, established on January 1, 1980;

nuggets.text: A Board of Trustees runs it.
nuggets.section: Md. Code, State Personnel and Pensions § 21-103
nuggets.quote: There is a Board of Trustees for the State Retirement and Pension System.

nuggets.text: Political subdivisions may participate in the employees' systems.
nuggets.section: Md. Code, State Personnel and Pensions § 31-102
nuggets.quote: the governmental units that are eligible to participate in the employees’ systems are:
